title: Show relative timestamps on deck cards
description:
Deck cards showed an absolute date (`3/10/2026`), which tells you nothing at a glance about whether a deck is stale.

- Adds `formatRelativeTime(target, now)` in `src/lib/relativeTime.ts` — minutes/hours/days, singular and plural, clamping future timestamps to "just now" (the API clock can run slightly ahead of the browser's)
- `DeckCard` renders it inside a `<time dateTime>` element, so the exact timestamp stays in the markup in machine-readable form
- Unit tests cover the unit boundaries, the singular/plural switch and the future-timestamp clamp

No API or schema changes.
